newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to revert to trade deficit in '97 - Chase.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to revert to trade deficit in '97 - Chase.

text.p: Mexico will go back to recording a trade deficit in 1997 on the back of import growth registered in recent months that will go through to next year, the director general of Chase Manhattan's Mexico office said on Thursday.
John Donnelly, speaking at the annual gathering of the Mexican Institute of Finance Executives in this western city, added that he did not see the deficit reaching the proportions recorded in 1994.

"Imports continue to grow...we are going to go back to having a (trade) deficit, the country cannot continue having a surplus right now, but the deficit will never be one like in 1994," Donnelly said. He added that increasing exports were counterbalancing the import surge.
